summary: Open-weight model inference clouds (Fireworks, Base10, Together, Modal, Cognition) are growing faster than OpenAI or Anthropic
summary_extended: Baker argues that open-weight model inference infrastructure companies — specifically Fireworks AI, Base10, Together AI, Modal, and Cognition — have been growing faster than frontier labs OpenAI and Anthropic since at least summer 2026, with the trend persisting into October 2026 even as Anthropic itself reaccelerated. He presents this as a direct observation from portfolio company data and private market deal flow, describing the growth rates as 'extraordinary,' with these companies posting double-digit growth even in the window between first term sheet and funding round close. The implication is that demand for open-weight model inference is structurally outpacing demand for proprietary frontier model APIs, suggesting enterprises and developers are increasingly routing workloads to open-weight infrastructure rather than OpenAI or Anthropic. Because all named beneficiaries are private companies, there is no directly actionable public equity trade from this thesis as stated, though it may have implications for public cloud providers or open-source model hosts if the trend scales.
